requirements.requirement: Shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: Build provides a 3-level shelf form (piece:0,0,0;full + piece:0,0,1;full + piece:0,0,2;full with cover:0,0,2;full;top and piece:1,0,2;half-n with cover:1,0,2;half-n;top forming ~304x144 mm deck) and staged with book-stack prop, but the configurator only checks geometric fit and mesh clash (check_build: clear) and 3D-printed plastic strength, load rating, material and safety cannot be verified. No load test is performed — do not load with 50 kg.
Two drawer modules installed: drawer:0#1,0#cut at level 0 (piece:1,0,0;half-n) and drawer:1#1,0#cut at level 1 (piece:1,0,1;half-n), both accessible on the front face.

finish.summary: Built a 3-storey hexagonal shelf form (~344×240×291 mm parts) with flush top covers forming a book deck and two south-facing drawers (levels 0 and 1). Staged with a book-stack prop to show use. House rules applied: capOpenFaces and lockJoints. Load rating to 50 kg cannot be provided by this system — all strength/load requirements are unverified and must remain unmet.

Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Your shelf unit needs to hold a lot — I'll check the kit for drawer and shelving options and see what's possible.

result.note: Ask again with a family or a few words (text) to see the parts themselves.

A drawer sits on the cut face of a half base: place a half base (variant half-n, half-s, half-e or half-w) first. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
